verdict.rationale: WorkOS provides MCP-based agent access to manage dashboard data (create/read/update orgs, users, etc.) and fraud/bot detection (Radar), but there is no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to the user from their own data — no analytics dashboard, anomaly explanations, or recommendation features are documented. missing for 10: any AI-driven insights/analytics dashboard, evidence of suggestion generation from customer data, or reporting on usage/security patterns via AI.
